messages.text: Can we exchange 20 demo dollars for 10 demo coins?
Offer: 20 DEMO-USD for 10 DEMO-COIN. Amina signed both sides of the agreement.
Agreed. Both owners signed the same exchange.
Passing 6 received demo coins to Chidi, with the signed exchange evidence.

note: Actual WebCrypto signatures/encryption; independent keys in one process; synthetic roots and settlement model. No chain or transport integration.
